title: Ukiwa Nagoya, tembelea hafla za wikendi katika Hisaya-odori
label: Hisaya-odori

text.Everything, Nothing: Kila kitu kipo, lakini hakuna kitu
text.Even for me, living in Nagoya, Nagoya is: Hata kwangu ninayeishi Nagoya, ni jiji lenye kila kitu lakini lisilo na kitu cha pekee.
Kwa maisha ya kila siku, kila kitu kipo.
Lakini bado hakuna jambo la kipekee.
text.If you ask for \"the one place you must: Ukiuliza “ni sehemu gani lazima uitembelee Nagoya?”, nitafikiri, “Hmm, ingekuwa wapi?”
text.But if you want to do something fun in N: Lakini ukitaka kufanya jambo la kufurahisha Nagoya,
text.I recommend the street in front of the T: ninapendekeza barabara ya Hisaya-odori iliyo mbele ya mnara wa TV.
text.🎪 Food stalls and the TV tower: 🎪 Vibanda vya chakula na mnara wa TV
text.Here, there is some kind of event on alm: Hapa huwa kuna hafla karibu kila Jumamosi na Jumapili.
text.At least on about 1 weekend every 2 week: Angalau mara moja kila baada ya wiki mbili kuna hafla ya wikendi.
Safari hii kulikuwa na hafla ya Thailand.
text.When you want to kill some time in Nagoy: Ukitaka kutumia muda kidogo Nagoya, tafadhali njoo mwishoni mwa wiki.
text.There should be some event going on here: Lazima kutakuwa na hafla inayoendelea hapa.
text.I think it is nice to have a little fun: Nadhani inafurahisha kujiburudisha kidogo kwenye hafla hiyo.
